content.markdown:
## Scenario context

Decoupled system architecture isolating ingress, stateless logic, and persistent datastores.
The system topology organizes components across groups: Edge Traffic Ingress, Stateless Microservices, Datastore Infrastructure. Each component maintains isolated responsibilities to protect system throughput.

This walkthrough focuses on **Component Topology & Roles**.

Before making a design choice, clarify:

- The system topology organizes components across groups: Edge Traffic Ingress, Stateless Microservices, Datastore Infrastructure.
- Each component maintains isolated responsibilities to protect system throughput.

**Concepts in play:** data-warehousing-lakehouse, caching, api-gateway, api-security-oauth2

## Stage 1 — Data Flow & Inter-Service Invariants

- Stateless compute nodes scale horizontally while shielding underlying database clusters behind fast cache layers.
